Check model identifiers, scope, and required inputs

Source: R/stem-registry.R
check_taper_models.Rd

Diagnose unavailable equations, incompatible species, missing auxiliary measurements, and invalid auxiliary values. This does not assess statistical fit accuracy.

Usage

check_taper_models(
  model,
  spcd = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

model

Equation identifiers as a character vector. Required, without a default. Scalar identifiers recycle to the supplied species or auxiliary input count.

spcd

Numeric species codes to check against model scope, or NULL. Defaults to NULL, omitting scope checks. Other model and auxiliary checks still run.

...

Additional named inputs accepted by the selected model, with none supplied by default. Numeric inputs must be finite: positive upper_ht1, upper_ht2, and site_index use feet, positive upper_d1 and upper_d2 use inches, and positive basal_area uses square feet per acre. form_class accepts positive numbers. bark_ratio is inside diameter divided by outside diameter, greater than zero and no greater than one. decay_class accepts whole numbers from 1 through 5 and cull accepts percentages from 0 through 100. upper_bark accepts 'ib' or 'ob'. Upper heights and diameters must be supplied in pairs. Only inputs declared by the selected model are accepted.

Value

A data frame containing problem rows only, with row (input position), id (model identifier), status (integer code), problem (description), and input (related input name). An empty table means no checked problem was found.

Examples

## Check the equations and species stored with the example trees
check_taper_models(model = example_trees$model,
                   spcd = example_trees$spcd)
#> [1] row     id      status  problem input  
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
